text: They won't Let me delete my account and data. Reduced rating. First off: this game is not like the ads(suprise suprise), it's one of those over done town-survival time-gated microtransaction games that is pay to win in the sense of: if you are willing to spend money on in game contents you get huge boosts and if you don't you won't come close to the strength of those that do. That said it's fun at first, then loses charm as everything becomes timegated without purchases.

I can't give this game more than 3 stars. it's a reskin of other games that follows the same format with very little to differentiate itself from the rest. Once you start playing you'll find that you've encountered the same mechanics and same problems every player inevitably runs into; the waiting time for buildings to upgrade in order to progress in the game. There are some enjoyable aspects such as the asylum walking around healing people but other than that nothing pops out.

This plays like a LOT of other games with heroes that you train up, buildings you train up, resources you collect, etc. Game plays well and has good voice acting, but it doesn't feel like it has much depth to it. I was more interested in the "moving around picking up stuff and healing people" shown in the ad, but it seems that's only a small part of the actual game.

I just started the game, and honestly there's a lot of weird bugs. if you want to succeed quickly, it seems you have to purchase packs. also the weird automatic joining of an alliance is odd. there are a ton of bots in the game, which is alarming. and it's weird that the game automatically chooses a message to send to the alliance group chat once you join one. DEVS, you guys have a lot of cleaning up to do. I can see the potential in this game. but not with these weird instances.

Nothing like the ads. The playable ads are a bunch strategy mini-games that seemed entertaining. Instead, it's a base building game with a storyline, which can still be enjoyable. But then it opens into a game with other players on the server, guilds, and presumably a player vs player activities. I don't want that type of game anymore. I wanted the various mini-games that needed strategy for growth to stay ahead of the plague rats and win the level.

Not a fan of war games. Saw the ads and thought this was a single player game but it's not. You start off advancing your base which was fun andddd then it just becomes a war with other players. Pay 2 win with heroes, resources, extra builders, and much more. With that said, I'm not looking to spend more than 10 bucks so this isn't for me.

While I do appreciate that there are 0 ad commercials, the game itself becomes repetitive and boring. It lacks any excitement after a while (my current sanctuary is level 12). I paid $1.99 to upgrade my building tasks to 2 at a time, and I regret it now. I only bought it thinking the game itself would keep me entertained longer. But alas, I am uninstalling due to feeling bored.

They actually told the truth, after playing for a good while, there weren't any ads. The part where you run around curing patients, and carrying money, medicine or whatever else is the average, training-wheels tutorial. Then you have an average town builder. Then they also add an average idle battler. Don't forget the ways to increase productivity and battle power is gated by an average gacha. This game has it all, and an average grade does not equal bad. No offline is disappointing.

The game is in fact, like some of the ads. I haven't gotten far enough to say they're all real or they're all fake but it's at least the framework of the ads for a portion of the game. Unfortunately the game is a type of game that I frankly hate, the clash of clans type raise your power and fight. A city builder of sorts. It's not great but not bad either.

it's pay to win, they've put ads in the game as pop ups and random mechanics stop working. its flagged by Norton as a data mining app. the game censors all of its competitions, and anything else it doesn't like but allows explicit chat which may not be the best thing for teens to be lured in to (please change the age rating! ) if you can look past all of that, it's a strategy war game and the server you end up on will be ran by whoever has the biggest cc collection. you can't merge to other serv

the app auto mutes you if you respond to too many messages (apparently more than 3?) and you can't appeal it. You can't talk to a human to try to fix it. it claims it's a temporary mute but it's been almost 15 days which is absurd, especially when I didn't say anything inappropriate. I understand it's to try to combat bots but it's absolutely not working.

It is definitely pay to win, but that wouldn't be so bad, and I would actually pay, if you didn't just get bounced from Allliance to Alliance constantly. And if you don't have/use/like discord, don't even bother trying to play. Games shouldn't allow other users to require you to install other apps. It is a little like the ads, and I have played this style before, but the constant eviction from every alliance the game auto joins you to makes it unplayable.

Need someone from customer service to get in touch with me. I can't log-in and it keeps taking me back to "log-in error" screen. It asks me to bind my account and provide an OTP, but surprise! in order to do that, one must be logged in. smh. The url address they give you to contact a person is not a working address.Just one more and I will delete this game. Waste of time and energy. If you spend money on this game, beware! You won't be able to get your money back since they won't let you log in.

I was hoping this would be a Farmville style game where you could help friends fight back the plague. It wasn't, it was the style where once you hit city level 10 you loose your shield and then get bombarded by the open world when you don't log on every day and keep renewing your shield. The game was fun up to that point, and if you like those games this one was def fun

My sister BEGGED me to play this game and I must say, I don't get how she (or anyone) finds this fun. the hospital managing aspect that was so heavily advertised is hardly a feature since most of what you do in this game is wait for buildings to upgrade. This game isn't p2w it's pay to play. almost all of the characters look ai and all the same. I shouldn't have to wait 12 hours just to have enough XP to lvl up a character TWICE. I tried to like it but I'm ready to quit after less than a week

Let me save you a few hours of time: This is another Evony / Whiteout Survival clone. You will play the first few hours thinking this is a cool, linear survival RPG with a decent story. Then once you get far enough you will realize it's one of those massive open map PvP games, where you build up your town only to have it get repeatedly plundered by PvP tryhards. There was nothing in the intro or advertisements which hinted at this. So annoying. These games are fun until they just AREN'T. Sigh.

It was advertised as not having ads or paid progression in an ad. It doesn't have ads but the main UI is filled with trying to make you buy their stuff. Literally 2/3 of the screen is filled with "pay $29.99 for VIP" or "buy this character for $9.99". For an advertisement to say there is no pay to win and to see this is sad. The art work seems AI generated, gameplay is a little slow to begin with but even slower after you need to upgrade things.

I found the playable ad to be more fun than the real thing. Would rather this be single player experience only and not pay to win. That said, if you enjoy the usual multiplayer mobile base builder that has been copied in concept to death ... this at least feels like an improvement. But this wasn't in the ad and is not the game I wanted to play.

I changed my rating. I was enjoying the game. It started exactly like the ads. Then it started turning into yet another base building game. But I could still go back to the curing patients/expanding the hospital part like the ad. So I kept playing. And then I logged in to see all my defeats by raiding players. I immediately unistalled. I wasn't wasting my time in a game where my work is wiped out when I'm not online.

I can't give this game more than 3 stars. Its a good playing game, however it's just like every other game out there of the same base. The problem is like every other like game, the waiting period for higher levels is far too long. A month(s) or weeks to wait for a building to level up or research to complete??? Come on, that's ridiculous! Makes the game NO LONGER FUN TO PLAY. That's why 70% of players quit these games. And the constant spending just to stay on top? It's pointless to play.

Missleading ad. pay to win. An okay game but nothing at all like the playable ads that it pumps out. In 3 days worth of playing I have seen no ability of 'strategy' the game dosent just hold your hand but it drags you by the nose on what you can and can not do. Its also a clan/global raid type game where your location can be invaded by other players to loot your resources. In the first day alone there are over $50+ worth of "buy this to succeed" micro transactions.

Starts out as a fun game, if somewhat awkward in the interface and game play. After several hours over a few days, however, it becomes evident that you must pay a lot of money and join the cults err alliances before you can progress. I don't mind investing a little money, but $20+ on a rotating schedule in addition to frequent buys of $5 makes this nothing but a money grab. On top of all that, the healing part of the game from the ads is only a very small part. Don't bother.

Fun to a degree & really doesn't have 3rd party ads, but there are constant in-game upsells. If you want a cozy little hospital game, this isn't it. Once you get a few levels in, everything becomes about the interactive guild feature, and they are already dominated by high-level players. Get auto-added into one of the big ones and the mods try to force discord membership, but starting your own means no members (or events). Cute concept but in its current state, pretty meh after 2 weeks.

All of these games are the same. Boring. There is one mechanic (healing patients, fighting zombies, etc) that they advertise in the game. It's used a lot in the beginning, then it's gets harder and harder to gain enough resources, eventually they try to force you into an alliance. This is designed to create competition. There is always a bunch of Whales or devs on your server and eventually the only way to keep up is to pay money.

I like it, Ive never seen a game combine the elements this game does! My only issue is the lack of choices. I just downloaded, im level one, and it WOULD NOT allow me to make my own choices. It forced me into automation. I get teaching you the basics, but I wish I could have had more choices. If anything, I wish you could fire NPCs after the tutorial. I also dont like that you HAVE to hire nurses before building more wards.

it is Very VERY slow, and it is more of a game to fall asleep playing. I hope it picks up a little faster, and it looks to be a cash grab game you have to spend money to advance. It will be a long long road to walk and the blister will be painful, LOL, too confusing and the game funnels down to the point that you are almost forced to purchase items to continue in the game. I could not find the path to win the battles and upgrade the worriers. just to darn old for me to play. uninstalled it.

This is a microtransaction game. That means no ads but you can't progress unless you make several large purchases in order to advance. This game has great graphics, interesting storyline, and easy to learn game system. However, I have read from fan sites it takes a player with $1,000 a month to burn to make any headway in this game once you reach level 8. If you don't want to pay for food or bills then this is the game for you. I remember a similar game but it was a zombie apocalypse.

Not even 10 minutes in and the gameplay switches up. Character portraits are all AI generated from different games. Its inconsistent, details dont make sense, and really distracting/ugly. You can tell something isnt right and its not from the plague. Concept is good and the 2000s look feels nostalgic, but the more you look at it the worse it gets. Voices for characters change in different scenes. No ads, but why pay microtransactions if devs cant pay to make the game in the first place?

This game is definitely a very bad reskin of so many other much better games, the concept was interesting at first but quickly became boring and stagnant. While they like many other claim to be free to play they are not and if you choose to spend which very quickly you won't have a choice if you want to grow much less compete, you can not delete your account or any associated payment information and their customer service is nothing but a poorly programmed bot, so buyer beware.

Like others have said in the reviews below, this game is nothing but a lackluster reskin of other games that came before it, eventually pushing you to buy things to make progress faster. The use of AI for both character portraits and voice acting is very disappointing and shows the lack of care that went into this game. Would HIGHLY recommend NOT making any purchases because it's obvious the devs are just cash grabbing. 10/10 would NOT install.

The only way you're going to win this game is if you pay money, and I mean lots of money. strategy could be perfect, but there's someone out there that's just going to buy everything to win, so far every game I've played there are people that are just golden, maxing out their bases in one day and have an army of 30 people storm your position, the game would be awesome if there was a limit on what you could spend per match, The game is very addictive when you find players that are actually good

The game play is fine. The problem I have is that I wanted to delete the game. So I went to delete my account from their server. They ask you to select the boxes stating you agree to terms, and have no open service tickets. I selected the boxes and on the next screen conveniently my account has been flagged for suspicious activity, first time hearing about that. so they ask basic questions and why I'm deleting. I fill it out, submit and BOOM! Service ticket. Now I am unable to delete account. BS

DO NOT JOIN A DISCORD. There is a big problem with bots and scams in this game with the chat feature. The game has a preset course as well. It is good for burning time. You have to get through gameplay before you can even touch you settings and there are pay walls for some quilty of life features. You CAN'T really customize most aspects of your gameplay such as your base. You CAN'T dismiss notifications in the game that can only be completed with purchase. Not really consumer friendly.

Game is alright it's not like the advertisement. But a few days into it and lots of work put into it i get attacked relentlessly. Of course I do not have enough game money to shield constantly. I was attacked 20 times and lost all resources and troops multiple times. Game is not worth the effort. Deleting your account is another experience itself. It's unfortunate because the game has alot of potential.

Missleading. No real story. Many games meshed into one, none done good. There is no true tale after the pull in. I finished what I think is the campaign and it didn't trigger an end of game sequence. Less than basic strategy. No puzzles or character interaction. Just click to get items to make buildings appear and level them up. The rpg fighting element is not fun. All auto action. Stats don't seem to matter much, bad programming.

Been really enjoying this game and the variety of things to do in it. I agree with other reviewers Pay To Play allegations because it really seems like that's the case as some alliances have whales that regular players can't hope to keep up with. Regardless, I'm having fun and want to keep playing The game's help feature is an LLM which is really frustrating and off-putting and the art also looks like it could be AI generated (though I cannot confirm that) which are both big strikes against it.

THIS GAME IS JUST KINGSHOT. It looks like it's different with the clinic and helping people. however the basic structure and rules are the same. The goal is to get people to beat up on each other. Once you get to level 10, it's really player vs. player fights. Our server is already trying to boot off the players that do not want to fight others just blights The instructions are poorly written and sometimes wrong. They are the same as KINGSHOT because the have the same grammatical errors.

this is a great game! however, if anything goes wrong their support system is completely almost non-existent! I actually enjoyed playing this game so much for free that I started putting a little bit of money into it and then the game started freezing at a specific spot. the only assistance that is offered is you can open up a ticket and chat with AI and of course we all know how chatting with AI goes!

Love the game. but has a LOT of bugs lately and the fixes do not last tong. Compensation for bugs are low. Updates has been great within the last month but I wish that there were less survivor tokens when in the tavern. the ratio is way far off and sitting with 1k or more tokens is a bummer. it would be nice also if the things we pay for weren't so expensive or if they were grouped together better.

These games are misleading and I've finally learned my lesson. This game is advertised as free to play and ad-free and its true. But it also plays mind games with you. While you're playing for free it also flashes events at you to tempt you to spend money to get the rewards these events offer as little as .99¢ to get you started and soon you're thinking "can I afford 50$ for this. I admit I fell for it. I spent like 5$ before I realized how these games make me feel. I'm deleting it now.

I fought the game was fun at first but then I learned to pay to win game because there's a lot of things you kind of need to upgrading.It's one of those games where you have to grind.Honestly, I'm not a big fan of the grind game, but I did like to advertisements.It was good and overall other story in line was great, but I just could not stand how it was.Events pay to win and a lot of other stuff... well , not recommend it's a money grabbing game

This game's pretty fun. It's definitely another Clash of Clans clone, but it's unique in it's own way. It's also potentially the easiest of these types of games, there's not much need for strategy and resources are easy to come by. It'd be a good game to introduce someone to general strategy games. As of June 30th 2026, the only real issue I have with the game is the amount of bots. There're a lot of them. If they just fix that, then I'd recommend for a fun pass time.

This game advertises itself as a single player experience when in reality it is just another competitive multi-player experience where alliances raid other players for resources. The game has an interesting concept collect heros to build up, survivors to develop your base then battle the evil wizard and his minions to stop a plague. Unfortunately that is ruined by allowing players to raid each other for resources and ends up being a reskin of the same type of games that came before it.

Was great until they started updating things now the app won't stay working. U open it and it's fine then two minutes later it doesn't work. Restart it and u get maybe another minute of play then it freezes again. I'm about to delete it abd I'm very disappointed. I have gathered a few friendships once I delete it I'm not sure I will find my avatar and aliance again. Otherwise I would have given it five stars it was fun while it lasted

I really liked playing the game, but there are more issues than just bugs wrong with it. I got muted by the game and I played for about 7 days and I still wasn't unmuted. My alliance leader got banned for an unknown reason. I started another account, but with that account, I kept getting expelled from the alliance and was in a different one every time I reloaded that profile. There's supposedly a lot of bots and scammers so a lot of alliances require you to give them your discord info.

Like others have said. The plague sanctuary play from the ads is fun, but the rest of the game is a clone of other games like Last War. I could deal with that if it wasn't for all the bots, somehow getting batted around alliances I didn't join, and getting spammed with bot private messages. You don't know who is real and who isn't. Terrible experience.

Game is fun for the most part.... and you quite literally never have to worry about not having enough resources. I have so many resource bags that ill never be able to use them all.... Devs, if you read this, you should think about adding a function to trade resource bags for speedups. Id be fine if 100 blue bags only gave me a 5 minute speedup. We need something like this.

I've been having a lot of fun playing. the story is cool. the game play is predictable, but also they have really cool events. my only complaint would be it's so easy for your soldiers to die, and it takes so long to make new ones. I don't mind spending a little money for speedups, but it's just not feasible with how little you get vs how much you need. it's starting to make participating and supporting my alliance difficult and I fear this will be the reason I eventually have to quit the game.

The beginning of the game is fun, just like the video you saw. You will get to be a doctor and help people, building a place to treat them. However, when you reach a certain point in the game, it will be just like Whiteout Survival or Kingshot, if you've ever played them. You get to build and upgrade your army and fight alongside your alliance. It's quite fun if you have money to pour into it to get new UR (Elite Characters, which are released every week, and the only way to get them is Money.

Welp, they got me for $60-80. Uninstalling. It's a human habitrail wheel. There's no skill required. Grind, push buttons, endless click click click, do this do that to collect whatever you like, but level level level which takes no skill and little strategy. But money? Definitely! Rush that build! Add a queue! Congrats, you're a pay pig! It was somewhat fun for a few levels but the ramp up was insane. The social interactions aren't really; it seems to automatically post to simulate activity.

Almost like the ads. I'm still in the beginning, so I'll update later. but if you've ever played "Kings Choice" or "Whiteout Survival", its very much like those games but with more cut scenes and cooler story line. I wish it was a console game. I'd buy the box for whoever they played on. Very cool so far.

I have seen EXACTLY ZERO ads that show Last Asylum gameplay. It is a town building game with the move space by space around for "exploration" to expand. You have to get antidote for the Mayor's daughter so she doesn't die. It is the same game as about 20-30 others out there. Oh, and can we stop calling these "strategy" games? It is a linear story with no thought that needs to be put in aside from which "warrior/hero/fighter" to put EXP into after some gacha rolls in a Tavern.

The amount of bots has the whole community questioning every person who connects. The spam "are you a bot" messages and guild removals for lack of discord or "you're a bot" assumption simply ruined the experience for me. Not too difficult to get into, it's no different than any other resource collection with guild based multiplayer mobile game. No ads, which is what gave this game a much more positive rating than it would have been otherwise.

It was fun in the begining just like the ad said but quickly turned into a ptw game that keeps crashing, rarely lets me type in game, filled with creeps and bots. I got muted for trying to get people to join my alliance and the ai support bot can't answer when it lifts and it seems to vary by person if we do the same thing as someone else they can be muted a few hours while some are muted for a month or more. If you get kicked from an alliance it auto throws you into another. Barely playable!

Good at First then they keep adding more to upgrade to continue the game. It's not like the ad and after level 8, they keep adding buildings to upgrade. It's worst than Infinity Kingdom. Speaking of Infinity Kingdom, players in game try you to download and play other games. It's exactly like any hero game where you have to upgrade, join an alliance, and participate in battles.

NOT an offline game. it's semi like ads, but you quickly find out it's a p2w pvp game like WOS and oh so many others. not a single player game. no intrusive ads right now, but all the buy this thing, and buy this hero and that hero make it very obvious that it's a pay to win, especially when you are shown that it's not a single player game that it's pvpve instead. was really looking forward to playing a strategy game that was truly single player.

Absolutely awful, Super easy controls but the tutorial is never ending, Ignores key features making you click things first no reason, I had hopes for it to be a time killer but it instead became extremely annoying when I kept getting randomly locked out and unable to play until I did exactly what it wanted me to, No amount of restarting the app would stop the lock out, So it's a hot nope and a ton of ads and pop ups that try to trick you into clicking buy to force money to he spent.

I have enjoyed this game! I haven't seen any ads, its fun to play. It feels like a game from the Wii instead of a phone game, its absolutely delightful to help this town fend off the plague! Honestly, its refreshing to play, you can make in app purchases, I personally haven't so far and have been having a grand time. So its not like other games that force you to watch ads to even beat the level. Its what a game should be! I am enjoying the story too!!! highly recommend!!!

I is a fun game to play and keep you busy. Like most games, it wants you to pay to advance or speed things up to give you advantages. You can play without pay so far as I have gone but it has been slow going compared to the pay as you go players. Otherwise a fun and interesting and engaging game that will keep you busy and engaged with your alliance to win challenges together.

i found the game really fun but when i found out that you have to put your village on a world map with other players. i was heavily discouraged to play. Knowing i could lose everything in one well swoop makes me not want to play. im not the type of person to play such games where you can lose all your hard work in 4 seconds. Other than that its a great game

It's a fun game. a basebuilder and army builder. you've got a power level. upgrades take forever at higher grades. whatever. same as the rest with a plague/ zombie skin. Expect to pay a lot of money to not get stomped by other players. Some of the prices are ridiculous. 100 bucks for a base skin?

Amount of Bots are insane. I genuinely like the game. I think its good, but the amount of scammers/bots is just way too much. I think the mechanic where you can go inside your main base and manage it is unique. I think it has some unique mechanism. But its like every other game that is a "kingdom" management where you join a guild and compete with other guilds on a large scale.

Game is *somewhat* like the ads but is such a small part. Don't play this if you don't have 100's of dollars to spend. Fun for about a week, but it's the most Pay2Win I've ever seen. With increasing amounts of heroes that literally cannot be attained ANY other way than by directly paying for them. You will quickly become stagnated whale-food. Sad, sad excuse for a game.

Another city builder war game. It misleads leads you with the ads into thinking it's something else, but it's not. I give it 2 stars for the art style and characters. Though it's pretty much a copy paste of whiteout survival. Utilizing the same kingdom system, basic layout and everything. It's also very heavily monetized. I played for less than an hour, and I had over six buttons on my screen with deals and promos for me to spend money. Disappointed.

The ads led me to believe this was a simple idle game. It is not. It is a war game with constant stress of continuous building/growth, getting into a top 10 alliance, surviving pvp with other players, and if you're lucky you'll be able to avoid bot accounts/alliances. And then it's also game politics to worry about. Keeping track of when events happen. Keeping track of when best to use certain chest rewards. It is a lot and it is *not* a simple idle game.

After level 7, takes forever to upgrade major buildings, even with alliance help. If you like this type of building and raiding other teams. There's too much maintenance required just to be competitive and just like the previous iterations of these types of games, it get boring after awhile, it's build, wait, rinse, repeat. No real strategy involved and it's minimally enjoying. You'd be better off spending your time on other games, i.e. merge dragons, similar, but it's a puzzle game too.

This game is indeed novel, and, full of strategy! Even though it is plot directed, the game still gives you important options. In the earlier stages, it is more of a directed tutorial, but, that is what is needed to increase player comprehension and enjoyment. I see great possibilities for this game, especially if there is a better chat feature, and, alliances are added to the game in the earlier stages. This is not a pay to play, and beginners can be on an equal footing, which is unusual!

I just downloaded the game yesterday and have barely been able to play it. It keeps kicking me off due to a connection failure and when I try to select the "fix game" button it does nothing. I do like the game play so far (what little I have been able to play) but its very frustrating when I can't play more than 10min at a time before getting kicked.

I must edit and reduce my review. Once you get to level 6 the game shows its colors and pretty much locks you down unless you pay to keep going. Unless you wait a couple days, it shackles unless you buy this...that and a bunch of other nonsense. Charge 10 bucks for the game and unlock it 💯 ------------------------- The play is builder, but they don't hide that. The character graphics are fun, voice work is great and the story is engaging. Finally, they blend ward care with zombies - nice

In a word, this game is trite. This is NOT a single-player game at all. The ad I played was more fun than this boring and shameless cash grab of a game. PvPvE games are overdone and uninspired. There's no reason that this game should have PvP or a forced sense of urgency through timed "quests." Far too many moving parts and time gates for upgrading buildings. I try to avoid games like this at all costs, but as I said, the ad was misleading and way more fun than this oversaturated garbage.

First I thought the game was mostly like the ads. Gave it five-stars. Then a bit into it you're right into base building, collecting wood and grain, rolling for heroes at the tavern, and fighting other players. The cool hospital mechanics take a big back seat to exactly what everything else does. If you want another base building, fighting other players, waiting for upgrades, pay to win, you sadly found one.

Thought it would be a fun survival/idle game but within the first hour or so it just becomes like all the other clan games. No ads which is great but the game starts out as one genre of game and then quickly turns into something way different. It fills your screen with micro transactions once you get to sanctuary 5/6 and then it becomes clash of clans. Not the game they advertised so I won't be continuing.

There is SO MUCH AI. I have seen several ads with different textures and styles, and all of which use AI. The voices in the game itself and the characters are AI. Given the situation we are in right now, this is disappointing. Also, the AI made it, not the people. That's weird, because it takes 0 effort to make AI. Why should people be rewarded for that? Save our planet yo. 🫤 In terms of what game entails, it has numerous bugs, like the coins not going into the boxes and refilling over and over

the game is a lot of fun up until you get to about level 15. Then there's an abrupt bottleneck that makes this game more mature than fun. Really weird design choice to remove the fun from a game mid game. (making it so hard to unlock herb garden 3, and the cost of everything being so expensive in herbs) Need rebalancing! Also the game is constantly dropping connection with the servers.

the game isn't as advertised. the ads are for a totally different game. the actual game play is just like a dozen other games in this genre. You build a base and an army then join an alliance and fight other players. I'm so disappointed. It is true there are no ads. but half of your screen is covered by pay to win links. you "need" this hero and those diamonds and gems. And they are on sale right now 4200% off.

This opinion is my own as a lifelong gamer. The game, is clever with their bait and switch method. They pulled me in with some good bait: a compelling story line, "The Dark Ages: a plague doctor trying to save a village from disease." I was with it...until the switch; then the real game was revealed: it's a game like Game of War, Mobile Strike and SOS. It is now those games, that pay for enhanced experience play. Yawn... already been there. But the game is well coded w/ good sound and interface.

I used to play Tribal Wars and Ikariam years ago, and at the time they were fascinating examples of the classic “farm and grow” strategy genre. This game instantly reminded me of that era, but with a much more polished and modern presentation; the art style is charming and clean, the interface is easy to navigate, and progression feels satisfying without being overwhelming. Building up your settlement, managing resources, and slowly expanding brings back that nostalgic strategy feeling.

So I was really happy with this game. but then it went from being a fun single player game to one that requires you to join a guild and do pvp. We aren't what we claim" moment. I'm very disappointed. I'm giving it 3 stars only because I enjoyed the first part. This game could have been awesome.

I loved it at first until it turned into a kingdom game that the ads didn't show you. if you like kingdom games u will love this but I thought it was going to be like the ads. I dont want long building times and have to worry about defending a kingdom or investing all my time into it or risking getting kicked from an alliance. 3 stars instead of 1 because if I did enjoy this type of game it would be fun with no ads.

here's the deal it has no ads. that's good. but the mix of mechanics are a bit strange. you have a hospital section which is tycoon type game. earn money, build up hospital, earn more money, and so on. that is actually fine but then you have the other half. and it is your typical build a base and hire hero's. honestly if more of the game was the hospital aspect or even the entire game would give a hire rating.

typical recruit heroes, upgrade settlement, fight, and repeat, your heroes do well for the first and second fight, but oh wow surprise, by the third, you struggle and a mysterious new recruit shows up to help. but not before the one you had becomes sick, and have to heal them multiple times for hours. and upgrades begin to become way to expensive. sad, the ads showed a plague doctor healing patients, but thats not the real focus here.

False advertisement. The game does start off nice and the graphics are amazing. But then it turns into one of those base building war games with tons of people pouring hundreds of dollars in it that you won't keep up with unless you do the same. Guilds that will kick you out unless you join their discord channel, rude and profane language. You name it. Would have been an absolute gem of a game without that part.

If you've played every other mobile zombie game, this one is nothing new at all. exactly the same as the last three games I tried. if you're looking for something to waste time, then this game is for you. Also very toxic community. I was kicked from four "alliances" almost just as fast as I joined. no warning, no reasons, just kicked. nothing to see here, uninstalling.

Went into this game thinking the art was sus but wanting to confirm. It's absolutely AI, which is a shame because the concept is neat. It's been a while since zombies were popular so it's nice to get some content in a genre I enjoy. Unfortunately, the story is clanker garbage, it hits all the "women are weak but hot so it's ok" tropes, all the male character designs are varied while every woman looks like a discount disney princess. I hope another studio scoops this concept up and does it right.

its better than all the other games you get ADs for. has a solid story. and I bet once you get past all the talking itll be a fun game to play offline. my biggest issue. everything is AI done. the art the voice line, i bet the story too, its all AI done. its cool when all the characters have voice lines (and I mean ALL the characters have something to say) but you can just tell by the art style its AI done. the voices sound like Alexa is running around with ChatGPT. disappointing.

Not a single player game. Go through the tutorial (that is very boring just do as they say when they say) and then it turns into another one of those join an alliance & raid the map type games. Hero designs look basically the same as other games. Plot is basically the same. nothing new here & not what I'm looking for. If that type of game is so great why do they lie in the tags saying it's single player when you have to join an alliance & there is pvp? Ads are a lie. 0 stars

Feels like AI slop, from the dialogue to the art. I've also seen basically the exact game before but as a hotel simulator. Same locations of initial rooms and everything. Makes me wonder if there's a template of code that you can then impose AI generated art onto, which leads me to wonder - was any actual, human effort put into this game? It feels almost insultingly low-effort. Why should we bother to play a game that no one actually bothered to make?

It starts cute as advertised, but then quickly turns into a cheap base building game dependent on participating in an Alliance. In the week I've played, I've been kicked from ten guilds - after donating a ton of stuff worth real money, mind you - all because I don't want to use a 3rd party software (Discord). Nobody should be required to download and install other software just to play your mobile game. I am uninstalling with prejudice - never again, this sucked so bad.

The tutorial and guides are WAAAAAY too much. Feels like I'm not even playing the game because it forces you to click and do things constantly. Not a big fan. Do a short tutorial and let US play the game. No fun in just clicking when the screen says click here. Thought I liked it at first but it's honestly strongly killing the whole game for me. There's also no where to send feedback on the app, just complaints, so sending feedback here instead

Just another game made to be as tedious as possible so that you'll spend money on all of the little packs. It seems like every 5 seconds there's a pop-up or studying for a $1.99, $2.99, etc pack that speeds up the progression of the game. Some waste your time. All you'll get from this game is frustration.

Dangerous. The mini games are okay. Nothing new I've seen this concoction before. But it's dangerous. I have a rule. I'll spend a couple dollars and support the devs. If I like it I'll keep spending. But if it feels overly predatory, I won't. This feels dangerous. Wants a super early surgery and review, and we all know the big transactions are coming up. I'll keep playing, because maybe I'm wrong. Doubt.

It's an amazing game so far but I wish it didn't use AI, I hope the devs will go through the effort of hiring voice actors or even using some of the actual devs for the dialogue, if neither of those are an option I recommend using Ace Attorney-esque sound effects for the dialogue. I also would like if they replace the AI character portraits with either actual illustrations or with expressions or poses using the in game 3D models. besides that I've enjoyed its artstyle & gameplay direction ☺️

It's basic as far as what you can do. The Ad part where you set up a hospital type building was about 5% of the game and really underwhelming. After being auto assigned a Alliance for about a week I was kicked from the group. I was on every day for a few hours and was top 5 on the leader board for one of the event types every day as well. After getting kicked though, and this is why it's getting 1 star, it auto assigned me a group and auto moved my territory. No revenge for me I guess. GARBAGE!

This is a rare game I feel excited to rate 5 stars. I had to stop after a certain spot in the story ( no spoilers) to come give it a rating. love the story so far as I was not expecting one at all to begin with. I actually enjoy these kind of phone games because they are simple and satisfying. Im very impressed at your creativity to combine this style with one of outpost Management. very good work. I hope you continue to grow and improve in your future. Stop reading and give it a play.

Turned out to be a huge disappointment in just under a month. Nothing like the ads. UI layout is a complete clutter mess. Disorganization reins; you can never find what you want, when you want. The amount of time you waste going through all the menus collecting free daily rewards and what not is another cancer. The amount of shiny gold "buy this, buy that, buy buy buy" became obnoxious pretty fast too. Pretty sure they're using AI for character creation. Devs are that cheap. Uninstalling it.

Maybe an enjoyable game for few, but not really. They make claims of being able to delete the account. It's a total scam. They ask you to fill in details quoting that there were some inconsistent activities on the account so you HAVE to give the details, but no matter what you fill it'll show an error. Absolute headache. Hope atleast someone from the customer service team helps resolve this. Just chaos!

I am playing this game for couple of months. It is a pay to win game. You have to buy: heroes, equpment, gearstone to upgrade equpment, raven epigraph chests, raven essences, diamonds, speedups. Over all you will have to pay for everything if you want to beat top players. Every week there is a new thing to buy. Without 20k€ you can't be in top. The good thing, you can meat and chat with people from all over the world, people are mostly frendly, without this I would delete the game long time ago

Expensive packs. Leveling is slow, there are daily challenges to earn rewards. weekly battles against other alliances and kingdoms. The game isn't like the ads as such. A 30 day subscription is now $50.90nzd. To many high power players will destroy you during events. Expect to spent $50nzd or more a week to get stronger to compete against the higher ranking and cause they're pretty much in your face. Buy this, buy that. Graphics are great but the developers are so money hungry it puts me off..

It's a typical p2w pseudo strategy game with (at least initially) interesting story. Build your base, collect resources, gather heroes, attack other ppl... Pay for anti-attack shield, relocation, more resources and heroes. Oh and fun fact - I was asked for this review - in game. I gave 3 stars and it didn't show up in google shop. That's how it has almost 5 stars.

Yet another base-building, hero collection, idle progression and alli war game. At first, I really thought it's about fighting a plaque, but no - the plaque only is the background story. Very soon its only about growing your base, joining an alliance and fighting zombies and other players. Well done intro leading you through the first hours. Very soon progress slows down and it turns into pay or wait. No ads? Countless for in-game purchases.

It's nothing like the ads. An endless slog of cutscenes and hyper-restrictive tutorials where you can't play for five seconds without interruption. Every click is forced, you don't get to make any decisions for hours (if at all, idk), gameplay is shallow, and it devolves into a stereotyoical basebuilder grind. I wonder if they make the games as unfun as possible on purpose. Also, devs seem to delete reviews they don't like, the one I left yesterday is gone.

It's been really fun, there is a great introduction / learning to the start of the game and if you can get in with a good alliance early (when it becomes available) it can really help you go far faster. There is a unique "roleplaying" like aspect to it; more like a storyline you follow perhaps that kept it interesting for a long time; it gets to a point where you are limited in what you can do before having to wait to do more though.

This game is just like the ads for the first bit, then you get into some decent team-based auto battler combat(I just wanted to run my little hospital but cool), then it expands into one of those Evony-type games where you're a camp on a map and players can raid each other, join a large alliance or get trampled...you know the type. Everything else is great, but I was NOT looking for that. hahaha

Customer service is either a liar or super incompetent. They gave me a wrong product for my purchase, so I filed a ticket. First they said can't exchange if items are used. Ignore comments about good story, gameplay, etc., probably paid comments, because there is no story, no gameplay, no characters. This is not even a game, it just tapping on your screen collecting resources and waiting for building and research upgrades (waiting time vary from say 10 minutes, to 2days at level 15). These kind of games are the main reason of gaming industry going down rapidly. Also, the problem is people buying boosts for quicker progress that leads to nothing.

The initial sorry in-base is quite enjoyable. But that doesn't last. After that it's a regular mobile MMO strategy game with absolutely crazy priced packages ALL OVER the place, trying to get you to spend tons of money. if you don't, you're gameplay is crippled (compared to those who do) - and you also don't stand a chance to actually be successful. There's also tons of bots. And every few minutes someone messages you, telling you to add them on discord.

Having played a lot of games of this type. I have been happy to see some clear differences between this game and others. Overall I am pleased with it. My only complaint is the marked lack of resource buildings. If you want folks to grow then I you need to provide enough baseline resource buildings in each type. Four to five is nowhere near enough especially with other games giving 6 to 10 buildings of each resource. The development team need to rethink that aspect and add more farms.

Too many things to do, not given enough time to learn what you are doing before something else is thrust upon you. Too much linear clicking only on what the game is telling you to do next. You have no free will to play as you want. too much fighting so nothing like the ads. Shame it's another misrepresentation of a game that could be fun, but instead is just a fighting game

This game is yet another base building survival game. The ads show a nice farming game, but thet's actually is about 1% of the gameplay. Very soon you will just gather resources and wait literaly hours (already at level 7) for the building upgrades. Exloration is just a one path, upgrade heroes trap. I woudn't even mind these if there was a casual part I could play while waiting for upgrades, but this is just a pay for play nonsense atm. The positive part is, graphics are nice.

The game was fun at first, with even a bit of story telling, now it's just repetitive. This is not a single payer game as advertised in the tags. You will be forced to join an alliance if you want to continue playing otherwise you will be excluded from certain rewards, boosts etc. Politely said, the system changes/new gameplays have been catastrophic. More worrying, reports of bots or problematic users is not addressed.

Becomes stagnant and boring after a few hours of gameplay. Not enough time to learn and enjoy whatever new action is introduced to the game. Overwhelming amounts of clicks you have to do to collect rewards, ingredients, offers, messages etc.You basically have to wait for buildings to upgrade to collect goodies and collect heroes to do boring as hell fights in order to progress. I can already see that I'll have to pay at some point. It gets stagnant very fast.

very pay to win, they are having UR heroes what u can receive just with real money, if you don't pay u can't play. i understand they need to gain money to make the game work, but really i didn't see so much passes in other games, what is bothering me so much is that you receive 1 UR hero and others are with real money, u dont have collect all, u have to click every thing, they have to lots of adjustments to make this game enjoyable for the free players.

One star removed for false advertising. This is actually a war game. The plague doctor theme is just a backdrop. It was an interesting plot though and I would have enjoyed a continuation. Another star removed for bugs and an unfriendly user interface. Gameplay design is solid and can be played for free with no ads at all. Alliances give it a nice social aspect, and the accelerated growth from allied help is nice. However, paying players are too overpowered and break the balance of the game.

The game had many potentials, the art was interesting, too bad that the gameplay is just like a copy of other annoying games that you need to do so many clicks and unnecassary waitings for zero prizes. I would prefer it not to expand further into so many repeated fight gameplays and upgrading every single thing...just too much for me.

The game strategy is fine but please reduce waiting time for upgrading. The important thing I want to say here is, please remove the cooling period of profile picture uploading. Terrible experience, getting constantly attacked and obliterated forcing you to spend money. 1.) This game is not like it's advertised. 2.) They should've made it like the advertisement, which was a fun gathering/survival type of game.

This game is a city builder like Whiteout Survival. Not for casual players. No ads so that is nice. Don't trust the ads, not the same mechanics. A lot of micromanaging and annoying reminders about everything! Level up is resource based not experience. Combat is algorythm not match-3, not entertaining. Waiting for tasks to complete unless you spend gems (money). Be frugal with time and money because it (the game) will take it. Uninstall after a week.

When i went out of my country, it says server error. So once i return back, i tried to reinstall, but it still say server error, wont allow me to join the game. I have put quite a few bucks into the game. And i ask for help on the customer service, no reply. Email to them, no reply. So i feel like i wasted my money. The customer service does not help at all.

Nicely balanced pay- vs. free-to-play game althought I would not recommend to expect totally free game. A couple of small purchases at the start take one over the worst constrains, and after that, is is not a must to keep paying. There are plenty of rewards so even almost free playing is totally enjoyable. I really like the theme and graphics, the progress over time doesn't get monotonous and compared to other games, repetitive tasks are automated. It's a win for me.
Awesome game. 80 days in. At least now they are giving us the chance to obtain UR heros not just by spending real money. Though upgrading them is pretty slow especially starwise. Love the game.

Super addictive strategy game! I absolutely love the alliance system, the teamwork, and the intense competitive side of the battles. It’s highly engaging, and there is always something to do, whether it's cooperating with your team or upgrading your base. The visual style looks amazing, and the helpful community makes the whole experience even more enjoyable. Best strategy game I’ve played in a while.

Surprisingly atmospheric soundtrack, and earnest characters, places it above many resource-gathering, pseudo-rpg games. Unfortunately, it falls quickly into the tropes endemic to this type of game. E.g., characters logically relevant to the plot soon become mechanically useless, as purple and gold characters (whose only trait and value is their color hierarchy and "coolness") appear. The initial engaging plot becomes window-dressing because of that, the "Alliances" mechanic, etc. Pity.

The game really is pay to play or you get left behind. is very laggy and keeps freezing, with them doing an update which fixes it to then an event loaded on causing the same issues. There customer service is a Bot, so good luck with that. So don't get too excited when an event starts as you will probably get killed and not realise it til 10 minutes after the fact, due to the lag (every event)

i like the game and the different things you can do. but hero progression once they hit 50÷ level is slow, it costs too much experience. also troops have reached the point where it takes 14h to train and you're depending on speed ups however, there is just as much speed ups you can have when your troops take 14h to train 🥲 you kind have to spend money if you want to progress quick

The story and mechanics are interesting and fun, and the mini characters are nicely animated, but I'd absolutely love the game and gave it 5 stars if it didn't have ugly AI generated characters and (I think) AI generated voice lines. False advertising, this is infact very pay2win and for the first hour ot so you dont really even play just click what it tells you. Really ugly ai generated character art. Its one of these generic build a base and attack other players that thrive on whales that wipe all the other players out. The clinic mini game is really simple and repetitive. Really bad i recommend avoiding this game.

For what its worth the game on its own isn't horrible, but its still very new and not a lot of content. Way too many P2W features, as is customary in these types of games, only thing that's annoying is that they'll just crowd your screen for the most part because its a vertical design. Combat is elementary if non-existent. Solo play in your own base with scenarios is more fun than the rest of the player v player content. Way too many bots and scammers, DONT GIVE OUT YOUR DISCORD!

Standard mobile game with lame combat and micro management. The dev wants you to pay-to-win and locks content behind paywalls/playwalls. They force you to play exactly how they want you to. There is no freedom of choice—your only real choice is to not pay a single cent. 3 stars because the core is okay for a quick distraction, but the aggressive monetization destroys any long-term fun.

if your downloading this because u seen an ad, DO NOT DOWNLOAD. it's nothing like the ad shows and is just a rip-off of that one hotel game(My Perfect Hotel). Rated purely on use of AI. It's clear through inconsistent art assets that they were AI generated, plus an ad that was obviously not actual gameplay. Sad, because it was an enjoyable game, but I refuse to support any developer that takes shortcuts that will kill the gaming industry. Do better.

really quickly lose any point in playing. I liked the doctor game in the beginning. but it rapidly turned into one of those town building games where it's pretty clear they just want to get paid. unfortunately just not enough here to warrant that. the game itself is well made tho quick downloads good graphics not glitchy.

the game starts great and it is fun... then it is a copy of Lords type game, asking for money in every corner, most likely will need a guild and pvp later on will require you to put money for shields and stuff like that the game DOESN'T NOT TELL YOU ON THE 1000 ADS that appear in other games. Overall, it's a good game, but it would be helpful to have an account selection option when opening the app. A skip button for the introductory scenes would also be appreciated, as switching accounts currently requires replaying the entire opening sequence every time.

Either it is a very long tutorial or the game is just "click the screen where we tell you to click" all the way through. It looks great and has a fairly interesting story (for an app) but I like a bit of puzzle or choice in a game not just tap, wait, repeat.

Similar to other games in this genre but still fun. Build up your sanctuary and heroes, join/build an active alliance, spend a little $ to speed up growth, and meet people from all over the world. If this is your first its a good one! Fair warning, this game is addicting and can easily take over your life. You may find yourself spending a lot of time joining events and challenges. SO FUN!

I was enjoying the beginning of the game until it went from solo village building to an online multiplayer game that's basically just a copy of kingshot. Why does every game need guilds that are mandatory for progression? This would have been so much better as a single player game.

The gameplay overall simple, interface is easy to understand however the character illustrations were all AI -not even in the same style-. Could you not hire an artist while there are a lot of artists struggling to find a job? I'm sure a lot of gamers would value real human art. Disappointed.

full of ads, clear strategy game to push ranks so people get the dopamine and spend money. i installed because of the ad where you walk around, build, kill stuf, however, i have playing for 2h and still didnt get that, just the boiler plate simple "strategy" game with gachas and full of "limited time offers"

A really good game. I currently have around 70 days of playing this game continually and with a good alliance it is an absolutely epic game that keeps bringing me back. There are elements of in store purchases and you can find yourself bombarded however you don't have to buy these and it doesn't affect the game quality at all

In the early years of the Internet there was loads of spam and banners you downloaded without even knowing it they would charge you, even without you knowing it. This game looks like such. About 1/3 of a game screen is covered with ads, buy packs and addons you don't need but they are there u till you paid for those. Or delete the game. Garbage designed to drain money.

Looks like yet another deceptive "pay to win" game. ° None of the game play matches the demo ° You're building a city ° You have to get resources from outside the city ° You very rapidly hit an insurmountable wall where you face a fight you cannot win and you can't upgrade/strengthen your heroes...unless you pay.

This game is too easy. You earn an insane amount of resources very early so there's no grinding or having to wait for things to happen. The game tells you what to do every step of the way so it's just mindless clicking. It is addictive initially but then you stop and think "what's the actual point here?"

As claims "no VIP, no speed ups". This is a bold-faced lie. not only is there a VIP system if you're not using it, you fall behind. not only is there a speed up system if you're not using it, you fall way behind. So it has VIP and speedups, but you can also straight up buy resources and rare materials for cash. The only thing you can't buy directly are soldiers, but you can buy power-ups and instant speed ups for them. Heros, which are what your soldiers support. can be bought for cash.

everything was going well at the start, but then once I logged back in, it keeps saying "connection time out". that lasted for multiple checks every couple of hours. my connection is stable, I just don't know why that popped up and not let me access the game.

The game itself is vaguely entertaining. However, there's no end to bots and scammers in the private chats. it started out a fun game until you get your base to level 6 then it forces it into a pvp raid style game where you raid other players for supplies and can be raided unless you spend money on shields expire . ends up turning into a Pay to win since you can buy upgrades and supplies with real money. would've been alot better if it stayed PVE with a social chat/Clan and stayed out of pvp game play. being the doctor running around upgrading and helping villages was the best part of the game

Pretty darn good. No ads whatsoever. I like how you can run the clinic and not just build/battle. Graphics are great. I enjoy the old-time affect. 5 stars, might actually spend real money on this one. Well done Devs.

I love this game, but the discord spam issue needs to be addressed. Alliance leaders force players to download discord and claim it's necessary for communication, then they refuse to promote and expel the people that don't. There's an in-game chat for a reason. Players shouldn't be able to make their own non-negotiable requirements for access to the game. Please fix this. 🥺 Otherwise, the game is perfect!

Another expensive multi-city building game. The first few minutes are fun, then it starts requiring money to upgrade the city and characters. Almost identical to the game Age of Empires with different graphics.

Been playing for a couple months; I have a good group of people here and that really helps keep interest in the game. Weekly events keep you from feeling too disappointed if you have to miss an event because you can always try to make the next one. Events that dont last all day tend to have several time slots to help work with people's schedules.

My husband and I enjoy the game very much. It is fun and there is always a challenge to complete. you can play fast or at your own pace and there will always be an alliance you will fit in. highly recommended with all the different facets built in to test your Hero's skills without losing troops or power but earning more rewards. You dont have to be a 'money player' and still show progress. Highly recommended!

Pretty fun, so far no ads like it claims. There are paid features, but no pay walls. If you are patient you can play the whole thing without spending money or watching ads. It's fully voiced and pretty impressive for a free game. I'm really enjoying it so far.

It's a good overall but I hope that when you level up production buildings they have better looks cause it's bothering me that it still looks run down and my sanctuary looks white & red polished while the other wood & cracked stone walls they're at level 10 and above I at least hoped that they change looks even if just cleaner look & the squad looks so weird with fence the fence is so thin but I like this game over a building looks just bothers me lol
